question: Does a band that widens with sqrt(time), recalibrated weekly on the four prior weeks, score better than the frozen Cycle Navigator daily bands on the same issue clock and data?

model.P0: last hourly close fully closed at or before T0
model.sigma: sample std of the last 168 hourly log returns ending at P0
model.h_k: hours from T0 to the end of UTC day k
model.band: P0*exp(+-z_q*sigma*sqrt(h_k)); families: range (day low/high) and close
model.z: q-quantile of needed z over completed asset-days of the 4 prior ISO weeks (proxy issue Monday 08:00Z), >=40 rows else 8 weeks else seed

issue_clock: T0 = first-in-main time of 05_CYCLE_NAVIGATOR/weekly/YYYY/Www/CYCLE_NAVIGATOR_FORECAST_FREEZE.json (same clock as CN). Days are scored only on bars opening at or after T0, for both A and CN.

scoring.primary: mean close interval score at alpha=0.2 over paired matured asset-days, as a fraction of P0 (lower is better)
secondary: full-day range containment (A q80 vs CN band)
A calibration: empirical coverage at q50/q80/q95 for range and close
scoring.cluster: ISO week (BTC and ETH share weeks)

decision_rule.win: A has the lower weekly mean primary score in >=6 of the first 8 prospective weeks AND the two-sided exact sign test over all prospective weeks so far has p<0.05
decision_rule.else: CN stays official; A continues as a shadow challenger
never: replace or edit a frozen past CN issue
promote on fewer than 8 prospective weeks
change params, seed or formula without a new version and a new pre-registration

design_selection_disclosure: Estimator and window were chosen from 9 variants (sigma 168h / EWMA 24h / EWMA 48h x expanding / rolling 6w / rolling 4w) on prospective-simulated W39-W46 (N=90 asset-days): sigma 168h + rolling 4w had the best interval score (0.1216 of P0) and coverage closest to 80% (close 81.1%, range 78.9%). W46 therefore informed the design choice and is reported as an out-of-calibration check, not as prospective evidence.

code.ci: .github/workflows/data-architecture-gate.yml step 'Validate Task2 Challenger A sqrt-time volatility band'

weekly_operation: After each CN week matures (Monday), run `score --week YYYY-Www` (T0 from git); write the score JSON next to the week's CN settlement. Integration into the existing weekly settlement is a separate reviewed change.
